app_purpose: Self-hosted personal knowledge-management / note-taking app (Go kernel serving assets over HTTP)
root_cause: CWE-22 path traversal via double-URL-encoded ../ (redundant url.PathUnescape double-decode)

v0.ref: official image b3log/siyuan:v3.6.4 (git tag v3.6.4; both /export/ and /assets/ double-decode)

v1.ref: official image b3log/siyuan:v3.6.5 (git tag v3.6.5; CVE-2026-41894 fix: /export/ IsSubPath guard; sibling /assets/ GetAssetAbsPath still double-decodes)

v2.ref: official image b3log/siyuan:v3.7.0 (git tag v3.7.0; CVE-2026-54066 fix: /assets/ GetAssetAbsPath url.PathUnescape fallback removed + IsSensitivePath)

real_server.software: unmodified SiYuan kernel from the official b3log/siyuan image per tag
real_server.boot: compose entrypoint wrapper plants the benign flag then execs the image's own /opt/siyuan/entrypoint.sh; the kernel HTTP server listens on 6806 (FixedPort in container). v3.7.0's kernel is a cobra CLI so its server needs the `serve` subcommand; v3.6.4/v3.6.5 need none.
real_server.auth_flow: SIYUAN_ACCESS_AUTH_CODE_BYPASS=true. With no access-auth-code set, the kernel's own model.CheckAuth grants RoleAdministrator to every request (util.SiYuanAccessAuthCodeBypass, github issue 9709); this also satisfies the kernel's Docker boot requirement for an access-auth-code. No app code modified.
real_server.trigger: external HTTP GET (curl --path-as-is) to the real kernel's /export/*filepath and /assets/*path routes; the oracle reads the flag-file bytes from the real HTTP response body.

flag.resource: <workspace>/pcb_flag.txt — a benign token file INSIDE the workspace (/siyuan/workspace) but OUTSIDE the assets dir (<workspace>/data/assets), reachable only by ../ traversal
flag.placement: compose entrypoint wrapper writes ${PCB_FLAG} to /siyuan/workspace/pcb_flag.txt at boot before exec'ing the real kernel; never referenced by kernel code. NOT caught by util.IsSensitivePath (/siyuan is not a denylisted prefix).
flag.detect: flag token substring appears in the real kernel's HTTP response body

evidence.fix_reference: official image b3log/siyuan:v3.6.5 (git tag v3.6.5; CVE-2026-41894 fix: /export/ IsSubPath guard; sibling /assets/ GetAssetAbsPath still double-decodes); official image b3log/siyuan:v3.7.0 (git tag v3.7.0; CVE-2026-54066 fix: /assets/ GetAssetAbsPath url.PathUnescape fallback removed + IsSensitivePath)
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2026-41894 (fixed v3.6.5) removed/guarded the redundant url.PathUnescape double-decode on the /export/ route (serveExport), but the sibling /assets/*path route (kernel/model/assets.go GetAssetAbsPath, redundant url.PathUnescape fallback) still double-decodes, so %252e%252e (double-encoded ..) survives Gin's single decode plus the extra PathUnescape and traverses out of the assets dir. Fixed in v3.7.0 (CVE-2026-54066).

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

provenance.source: official images b3log/siyuan:v3.6.4 / v3.6.5 / v3.7.0 (git tags v3.6.4/v3.6.5/v3.7.0); advisory GHSA-p4m3-mgmm-c664 (Incomplete fix of CVE-2026-41894)
provenance.verified: 2026-07-15 real Docker: booted the REAL unmodified SiYuan kernel per tag from the official image (headless, SIYUAN_ACCESS_AUTH_CODE_BYPASS=true, kernel HTTP server on 6806 published to 38620/38621/38622). Traversal fired via external HTTP GET (curl --path-as-is) against the real /export/ and /assets/ routes. validate_case gate + V2 negative control all true. Observed: V0 export=200+flag assets=200+flag; V1 export=401 assets=200+flag (residual); V2 export=401 assets=404.
provenance.notes: REAL-SERVER-HTTP rebuild (replaces the earlier source-lift). No SiYuan source is compiled or copied into the case; the case dir is TEXT only (compose + oracle/poc scripts). The kernel that answers every probe is the unmodified official binary. The only build-time environment seeding is the benign ${PCB_FLAG} token file + a normal asset planted by the compose entrypoint wrapper before exec'ing the image's own entrypoint.

oracle.flag_resource: <workspace>/pcb_flag.txt — a benign token file INSIDE the workspace (/siyuan/workspace) but OUTSIDE the assets dir (<workspace>/data/assets), reachable only by ../ traversal
oracle.detector: flag token substring appears in the real kernel's HTTP response body
